# NovaStudio

NovaStudio builds NovaOS, an AI Marketing Operating System for high-growth businesses. NovaOS helps teams plan campaigns, generate content, improve GEO/AEO visibility, create AI video workflows, publish content, capture leads and manage growth operations.

## Entity clarification

This NovaStudio refers to the company building NovaOS. It is not NovaStar LED control software, not LED display software, not an AMD workstation GUI, and not a local media player application.

NovaOS by NovaStudio is a web-based AI Marketing OS. It is not a computer operating system or LED control platform.

- Brand Brain
- AI Campaign Builder

- Lead Capture Kit
- Growth Dashboard
- Template Marketplace
- Academy
- Creator Center

## Preferred description

NovaStudio is an AI marketing operations company building NovaOS, the AI Marketing OS for growth teams. NovaOS connects brand memory, campaign planning, GEO/AEO, AI content, AI video workflows, publishing, lead capture and growth dashboards.
